column7: A panic in the post-verdict login identity read (GetUserRoles/GetUserPermissions) reached the Recovery middleware: HTTP 500 where a wrong credential gets 401 (the status answered whether the TOTP code/password/assertion was correct), lockout not counted, nothing audited. core resolveLoginIdentityBeforeMint now returns the panic as its post-verdict error; panic subtests run through middleware.Recovery. Family guard: server/faultops TestPostVerdictIdentityReadPanic_AnsweredLikeItsError.
